configurations.name: Pocketfin (window)
configurations.//: F5. Breakpoints anywhere in the portable layers work, which is what the platform split is for. Arrows are the d-pad; W A S D are the face buttons where they sit on the console -- W triangle, A square, S cross, D circle; Enter START, Shift SELECT, Esc quits.
configurations.//cwd: The repository root: jellyfin.txt, run/ and the poster pack are all relative to it.

configurations.name: Pocketfin (window, console link speed)
configurations.//: The same app with the network pretending to be 8x slower than the console's 2.8 Mbit/s, and 8x its 80 ms of server think time. This machine fetches a poster faster than it draws a frame, so at full speed a page that pulls its whole folder and one that pulls the six rows on screen look identical. Change the number to taste; 1 is the console itself.

configurations.name: Pocketfin checks
configurations.//: The portable suite. It drives the real screens and leaves a capture of each in run/pocketfin-link/.

configurations.name: Pocketfin checks (one group)
configurations.//: Asks for a group and runs only that one. The argument is a PREFIX, so `pos` takes posters and poster-cache. A prefix that matches nothing runs nothing and says so -- read the count, not the absence of failures.

inputs.description: Group prefix (audio boot catalog chain clock clock_film compose conn decode detail element fmp4 frame gfx home_page http item_row item_sort jfquery jpeg jpeg_header json layout link listing log media mem offline pages platform player_page poster-cache posters prefs remote report screen scroll segments session settings standby start stream text visible_art)
